statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-81872 (GHSA-hjf4-fphr-2h65, GO-2026-6615): under exporter backpressure the BatchProcessor in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/log can spin in a tight loop, because its poll goroutine immediately retriggers itself when the non-blocking export buffer is full, so high-volume log emission can exhaust CPU. It is fixed in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/log 0.21.0 by commit ba71b09 (pull request 8620), which replaces the poll loop and buffered exporter with a single worker that owns dequeueing and export: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/security/advisories/GHSA-hjf4-fphr-2h65, https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/commit/ba71b09e6ed272e93a669aeaec1e98b1df4cc582, https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/releases/tag/sdk/log/v0.21.0 . The commit is in the sdk/log/v0.21.0 tag and not in sdk/log/v0.20.0. We read every published jaeger-dev package for Alpine 3.24 in the DHI Alpine repository: 21 builds, 2.19.0-r1 to the current 2.23.0-r4, each for x86_64 and aarch64, every download checked against its index checksum. Each package holds one file, /usr/bin/jaeger, a Go program. Its build information lists go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/log v0.19.0 in 2.19.0-r1 to 2.19.0-r4, v0.20.0 in 2.20.0-r0 to 2.20.0-r5, v0.21.0 in 2.21.0-r0 to 2.23.0-r3 and v1.47.0 in 2.23.0-r4. We read the Go function table (pclntab) of every build with a reader that finds runtime.main and main.main in each of them. In 2.19.0-r1 to 2.20.0-r5 it contains the code the advisory describes: (*BatchProcessor).poll, (*bufferExporter).EnqueueExport and (*queue).TryDequeue, reached from NewBatchProcessor and (*BatchProcessor).OnEmit. From 2.21.0-r0 it contains the fixed worker, (*BatchProcessor).process, (*BatchProcessor).exportBatch and (*queue).Dequeue, and none of those three removed functions. In 2.20.0-r5 and 2.21.0-r0 the function table's source paths name sdk/log@v0.20.0/batch.go and sdk/log@v0.21.0/batch.go respectively. 2.21.0-r0 is the first fixed build for this owner.

CVE-2026-81872 (GHSA-hjf4-fphr-2h65, GO-2026-6615): the OpenTelemetry-Go log BatchProcessor can busy-spin when its export buffer is full. Versions of go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/log before 0.21.0 are affected (https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/security/advisories/GHSA-hjf4-fphr-2h65, fix https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/pull/8620); sdk/log 0.22.0 and 1.47.0 contain that commit. Read the Go module list (go version -m) of /usr/bin/alloy in every published alloy-dev package for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository, amd64 and arm64 (1.18.1-0 to 1.22.0-16; 1.21.2-0 is published for arm64 only), each checked against the index SHA256; both architectures match build for build and no build replaces the module. The sdk/log module is v0.20.0 in 1.18.1-0 to 1.19.2-6, v0.22.0 in 1.19.2-7 to 1.21.3-5, v1.47.0 in 1.22.0-0 to 1.22.0-16, so the range ends at 1.19.2-7.

Read the Go module list (go version -m) of /usr/bin/alloy in every published alloy package for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository, amd64 and arm64 (1.18.1-0 to 1.22.0-16; 1.21.2-0 is published for arm64 only), each checked against the index SHA256; both architectures match build for build and no build replaces the module. The sdk/log module is v0.20.0 in 1.18.1-0 to 1.19.2-6, v0.22.0 in 1.19.2-7 to 1.21.3-5, v1.47.0 in 1.22.0-0 to 1.22.0-16, so the range ends at 1.19.2-7.
